checks.claim: Penn State's FRONTIER Project told the NRC on 2025-02-17 it intends to file a Construction Permit application for a research reactor based on the eVinci design at University Park, at a thermal power of 15 MWt
checks.evidence: Both counterparties' own dated statements give a different date than shipped. Penn State Engineering: 'Penn State submitted a letter of intent to the NRC on Feb. 28' [2025]. Westinghouse's newsroom: 'Penn State submitted a letter of intent to the NRC on February 28, 2025.' The NRC ADAMS accession for the letter, ML25059A029, encodes Julian day 059 of 2025, which is also February 28. No source supports 2025-02-17.
checks.correction: Penn State's FRONTIER Project told the NRC on 2025-02-28 it intends to file a Construction Permit application for a research reactor based on the eVinci design at University Park, at a thermal power of 15 MWt

checks.claim: NOITA to Oklo announced 2025-06-11 (re-issued after the 2023 selection was rescinded); 30-year firm-fixed-price contract to follow NRC licensing; DAF and NRC are preparing the environmental analysis.
checks.evidence: Oklo's own June 11, 2025 release confirms the NOITA for an Aurora powerhouse under a long-term PPA. A Sept 20, 2026 public-radio report citing Air Force officials says the site work for a draft Environmental Assessment 'was completed in July' 2026, that the draft EA itself won't be public until late 2027, and that officials 'hope to get the microreactor built and operational in 2030' -- confirming no contract has been awarded yet and the environmental analysis is still the live step, exactly as shipped.
